execution_status: specified; the SQL syntax parser and JSON structural validation are separate recorded checks, not evidence that these integration scenarios ran

scenarios.title: endpoint-specific units
scenarios.given_or_action: Same synthetic quantity/amount through Tushare daily and rt_k mapping.
scenarios.expected: 100.25 hands / 100.25 thousand yuan and 10025 shares / 100250 yuan normalize to 10025 shares / 100250.00 CNY; same-provider universal multiplier fails.

scenarios.title: null versus zero
scenarios.given_or_action: Feed null volume, explicit valid zero and NaN/Infinity text.
scenarios.expected: missing remains null; supported zero remains 0; invalid preserves raw value and cannot enter valid canonical observations.

scenarios.title: session and adjustment alignment
scenarios.given_or_action: Compare adjusted historical output against raw; compare 15:00 with postclose data.
scenarios.expected: Reject raw/adjusted mixing; produce unverifiable until source/session scope is aligned.

scenarios.title: mapping evolution
scenarios.given_or_action: Rename a required source field and add an unrelated optional field.
scenarios.expected: Optional field retained as raw drift; required semantic break pauses only this endpoint canonical publication; corrected mapping replays the same raw evidence.

scenarios.title: cursor commit order
scenarios.given_or_action: Crash after object upload before metadata commit; crash after metadata commit before cursor CAS.
scenarios.expected: Replay uses immutable object and batch idempotency; cursor never advances beyond durable raw objects and the last continuous source position.

scenarios.title: HTTP200 stale content
scenarios.given_or_action: Return the same yesterday payload repeatedly while polling succeeds.
scenarios.expected: last_transport_ok_at advances; last_new_record_at and canonical freshness do not; expected trading-session input becomes stale.

scenarios.title: source recovery and gaps
scenarios.given_or_action: Disconnect a stream; restore with a replay window containing duplicates and revisions.
scenarios.expected: Resume committed cursor, preserve duplicate receipt provenance, append revisions and record unrecoverable gaps rather than pretending complete coverage.

scenarios.title: multi-store publish recovery
scenarios.given_or_action: Crash after DuckLake commit with batch_id metadata but before PG READY manifest.
scenarios.expected: Recovery locates the exact committed catalog snapshot and publishes once; no second duplicate batch append; unregistered snapshot never appears as latest.

scenarios.title: PIT revisions
scenarios.given_or_action: Publish observation revision 2 after historical decision_as_of.
scenarios.expected: Historical observed-policy decision uses revision available at that time; new release may use revision 2; existing release and evidence unchanged.

scenarios.title: outbox ack loss
scenarios.given_or_action: Publish event, lose producer confirmation/status write, redeliver to consumer.
scenarios.expected: One inbox row and one business effect per logical consumer; same ID with different hash raises conflict; commit precedes ack.

scenarios.title: parallel holes
scenarios.given_or_action: Process stream sequence 10 and 12 while 11 is pending; also delay a transaction with an earlier sequence-generated identifier.
scenarios.expected: Continuous checkpoint remains 10; no max(id) commit-watermark query skips delayed events.

scenarios.title: release coherence
scenarios.given_or_action: Attempt READY with missing required plans or stale bars; attempt modifying components of a READY release.
scenarios.expected: Commit rejected; page remains on previous complete bundle; new release changes whole page coherently.
scenarios.required_validation: PostgreSQL deferred trigger and API integration

scenarios.title: release concurrency
scenarios.given_or_action: Race component update with BUILDING→READY publication in two DB sessions.
scenarios.expected: Release row locking and immutable guards prevent READY package mutation; successful publication is hash-consistent and includes one outbox event.

scenarios.title: scope-sensitive cache
scenarios.given_or_action: Same instrument/parameters queried for two accounts and for two availability or adjustment policies.
scenarios.expected: Different full keys and correct scope; no account position/plan leaks through a public or shared key.

scenarios.title: layout persistence and lost update
scenarios.given_or_action: Save layout, evict all derived caches, then race two updates against same layout_version.
scenarios.expected: Layout survives eviction; only one matching optimistic version update wins; second receives VERSION_CONFLICT.

scenarios.title: taxonomy PIT and sector ranking
scenarios.given_or_action: Change sector membership after a historical selection and regenerate report.
scenarios.expected: Original membership snapshot retained; sector ranking scope, classification owner/version and horizon remain explicit.

scenarios.title: ranking-plan identity
scenarios.given_or_action: Link ranking for instrument A/release X to plan for B/release Y.
scenarios.expected: Core trigger rejects identity/release mismatch; a mere FK to any plan is insufficient. Validate the trigger with a real PostgreSQL transaction.

scenarios.title: hot window completeness
scenarios.given_or_action: Store a partial bar range without marking the matching bars.window result READY.
scenarios.expected: API rebuilds from the pinned Lake snapshot or returns not-ready; it does not label a partial table scan complete.

scenarios.title: schema and client parity
scenarios.given_or_action: Generate TS/Python clients and roundtrip decimal strings, UTC timestamps, nullable quality values and unknown optional fields.
scenarios.expected: Client schema validates the same contract; decimals unchanged; invalid units/required-field breaks produce machine-readable errors.

scenarios.title: mixed workload capacity
scenarios.given_or_action: Replay planned ingestion with interactive ranking/chart workload and background research on declared data/hardware.
scenarios.expected: Publish raw timings, resource usage, backlog and consistency errors; decide ClickHouse addition using measured targets, not invented throughput.
scenarios.required_validation: benchmark, not executed in this delivery

scenarios.title: database deployment and constraints
scenarios.given_or_action: Create empty database and apply all integrated SQL; run deferred trigger, FK and concurrent transaction examples.
scenarios.expected: Migration succeeds and rejects designed counterexamples; static parser alone cannot count as this acceptance.
scenarios.required_validation: PostgreSQL runtime test, not executed in this delivery

scenarios.title: restore and reconciliation
scenarios.given_or_action: Restore app PG/catalog/object references/outbox to a consistent recovery point.
scenarios.expected: READY references resolve with correct hashes; pending events replay safely; source cursors and ledger versions reconcile; missing objects explicitly detected.
